The '''next census of Nigeria''' will be a detailed [[enumeration]] of the [[Nigerians|Nigerian]] [[Population and housing censuses by country|population]] that will be the fifth national [[census]] in the country since [[Nigerian Independence|Independence]].<ref name="Source1">{{cite web |title=Nigeria’s 2022 census is overdue but preparation is in doubt |url=https://theconversation.com/nigerias-2022-census-is-overdue-but-preparation-is-in-doubt-177781 |website=Nigeria’s 2022 census is overdue but preparation is in doubt |publisher=The Conversation |access-date=13 March 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220313033741/https://theconversation.com/nigerias-2022-census-is-overdue-but-preparation-is-in-doubt-177781 |archive-date=13 March 2022 |date=8 March 2022 |url-status=live}}</ref><ref name="Source2">{{Cite news |title=FG to deploy technology for 2022 population census |url=https://dailypost.ng/2022/02/13/fg-to-deploy-technology-for-2022-population-census/ |location=Lagos, Nigeria|newspaper=[[Daily Post (Nigeria)|Daily Post]]|access-date=13 March 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220313033931/https://dailypost.ng/2022/02/13/fg-to-deploy-technology-for-2022-population-census/ |archive-date=13 March 2022 |date=13 February 2022 |url-status=live}}</ref><ref name="Source3">{{Cite news |title=Census 2022: NPC solicits support of NSCDC to protect personnel, critical assets |url=https://www.vanguardngr.com/2022/02/census-2022-npc-solicits-support-of-nscdc-to-protect-personnel-critical-assets/ |location=Lagos, Nigeria|newspaper=[[Vanguard (Nigeria)|Vanguard]]|access-date=13 March 2022 |date=24 February 2022 |url-status=live|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220224015016/https://www.vanguardngr.com/2022/02/census-2022-npc-solicits-support-of-nscdc-to-protect-personnel-critical-assets/ |archive-date=24 February 2022 }}</ref> [[Census_in_Nigeria|Censuses in Nigeria]] have a controversial history and the next census will be the first national census held since 2006. Over 190 Billion [[Nigerian Naira|Naira]] (₦) has been allocated for the exercise.<ref name="Source2" /> The help of the [[Nigeria Security and Civil Defence Corps]] (NSCDC) has been requested by the Chairman of the [[National Population Commission]] (NPC) in order to provide security.<ref name="Source3" /> The census will also be notable for being the first digital census in Nigeria's history.<ref name="Source3" /> The plan is to use GIS technologies such as [[ArcGIS]] to aid with the planning process.<ref>{{cite web |title=Nigeria Applies Advanced Geospatial Technology for Census Preparations {{!}} Winter 2024 {{!}} ArcNews |url=https://www.esri.com/about/newsroom/arcnews/nigeria-applies-advanced-geospatial-technology-for-census-preparations/ |website=Esri |access-date=2 February 2024 |date=16 January 2024}}</ref>

Originally scheduled for 2016, the census was repeatedly delayed.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Fawehinmi |first1=Femi |title=The story of how Nigeria’s census figures became weaponized |url=https://qz.com/africa/1221472/the-story-of-how-nigerias-census-figures-became-weaponized |access-date=26 February 2024 |work=Quartz |date=6 March 2018}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |last1=Fatade |first1=Wale |last2=Akinyemi |first2=Akanni |title=Nigeria’s 2022 census is overdue but preparation is in doubt |url=https://theconversation.com/nigerias-2022-census-is-overdue-but-preparation-is-in-doubt-177781 |access-date=26 February 2024 |work=[[Quartz (publication)|Quartz]] |date=8 March 2022}}</ref> In April 2023, the census was postponed indefinitely by the Buhari administration in order to allow the new administration to pick a date.<ref>{{Cite news |last1=Mom |first1=Claire |title=2023 census postponed indefinitely |url=https://www.thecable.ng/breaking-buhari-approves-indefinite-postponement-of-census/amp/?/breaking-buhari-approves-indefinite-postponement-of-census |newspaper=[[TheCable]]|access-date=5 April 2024}}</ref> By April 2024, there was still no proposed date, although the 17 new commissioners were sworn in and produced a recommended date for President Tinubu.<ref>{{Cite news |last1=Are |first1=Jesupemi |title=NPC: No new date fixed for census |url=https://www.thecable.ng/npc-no-new-date-fixed-for-census-yet-weve-made-recommendations-to-tinubu/ |newspaper=[[TheCable]]|access-date=5 April 2024}}</ref> In July, the National Population Commission proposed a date of November 2024, but are still awaiting [[Bola_Tinubu|President Tinubu's]] approval.<ref>{{Cite news |last1=Habib |first1=Gift |title=NPC awaits Tinubu’s nod for census |url=https://punchng.com/npc-awaits-tinubus-nod-for-censu |newspaper=[[The Punch]]|date=20 September 2024}}</ref> There are concerns surrounding the use and management of the 200 billion Naira allocated for the next census, with the House of Representatives requesting an investigation.<ref>{{Cite news |last1=Chapi Odekina |first1=Abuja |title=Reps probe use of N200 billion on suspended 2023 census |url=https://www.vanguardngr.com/2024/03/reps-probe-use-of-n200-billion-on-suspended-2023-census/ |location=Lagos, Nigeria|newspaper=[[Vanguard (Nigeria)|Vanguard]]|access-date=5 April 2024}}</ref> Others, are calling for the Census to be delayed to more peaceful times due to the potential tension over population figures due to state revenue figures and representation in the [[House of Representatives (Nigeria)|House of Representatives]] deriving from population numbers.<ref>{{Cite news |last1=Nigeria |first1=Guardian |title=Nigeria not safe for population census now |url=https://guardian.ng/opinion/nigeria-not-safe-for-population-census-now |location=Lagos, Nigeria|newspaper=[[The Guardian (Nigeria)|The Guardian]]|access-date=5 April 2024 |date=7 March 2024}}</ref>
